[edit | edit source]

Quartz pillars can be mined using any pickaxe. If mined without a pickaxe, it drops nothing.

Development

[edit | edit source]
January 9, 2013 Jeb released the textures for snapshot 13w02a early, which included the textures for the Nether quartz block. This revealed there would be at least three variants: The standard block, a lines variant, and a chiseled variant. There are 7 textures for the blocks.[1]

Java Edition

[edit | edit source]
Java Edition
1.513w02a Added quartz pillars.
13w03a Pillar quartz blocks can now be placed sideways.
1.1317w47a "Pillar Quartz Block" has been renamed to "Quartz Pillar".
1.1418w43a The texture of quartz pillars has been changed.
18w50a The texture of quartz pillars has been changed once again.
19w11a Quartz pillars are now sold by villagers of the new mason profession, making all quartz-based building blocks renewable.
26.2snap1 Added sulfur cubes, which have the ability to absorb quartz pillars, providing the football/regular effect to the mob.
snap6 Changed effect from football/regular to slow bouncy.

Bedrock Edition

[edit | edit source]
Pocket Edition Alpha
v0.6.0 Added pillar quartz blocks.
Pillar quartz blocks can be used to craft quartz stairs.
v0.7.4 Pillar quartz blocks are now craftable in survival.
v0.12.1build 4 Pillar quartz blocks can now be placed sideways.
Bedrock Edition
1.10.0beta 1.10.0.3 The textures of pillar quartz blocks have been changed.
Pillar quartz blocks are now renewable, due to it being sold by stone mason villagers for 1 to 2 emeralds.
1.11.0beta 1.11.0.4 Pillar quartz blocks sold by stonemason villagers now cost one emerald. Master-level stone mason villagers have a 50% chance to sell a quartz pillar for one emerald as their trade.
1.12.0beta 1.12.0.3 Trading has been changed, master-level stone mason villagers now sell pillar quartz.
? Quartz pillars with the side texture on all faces has been removed, and replaced with the y axis-aligned pillar.
1.18.30? Trading has been changed; pillar quartz blocks are now sold by mason villagers in the same way as Java Edition.
1.21.20Preview 1.21.20.22 "Pillar Quartz Block" has been renamed to "Quartz Pillar" to match Java Edition.
26.20
Experiment
Drop 2 of 2026		Preview 26.20.23 Added sulfur cubes, which have the ability to absorb quartz pillars, providing the football/regular effect to the mob.
26.30Preview 26.30.20 Implemented all features from the "Drop 2 of 2026" experiment in vanilla gameplay.
Preview 26.30.27 Quartz pillars' sulfur cube archetype has been changed from regular to slow bouncy.

Data history

[edit | edit source]

Java Edition

[edit | edit source]
Java Edition
1.1317w47a The different block states for the quartz_block ID have been split up into their own IDs.
Prior to The Flattening, this block's numeral ID was 155. The numerical metadata variants of minecraft:quartz_block were as follows:
DV Description
0 Block of Quartz
1 Chiseled Quartz Block
2 Quartz Pillar (up-down)
3 Quartz Pillar (east-west)
4 Quartz Pillar (north-south)

[edit | edit source]
Pocket Edition Alpha
v0.12.1build 4 There exists a quartz pillar state with the side texture applied to all sides.
Bedrock Edition
1.10.0beta 1.10.0.3 The textures of pillar quartz blocks blocks have been changed.
1.21.20Preview 1.21.20.22 The different chisel type block states for the quartz_block ID have been split up into their own IDs.
